description: Test whether a business acquisition supports its debt. Takes the purchase price, the seller's stated earnings, the buyer's equity share and loan terms; returns the cash flow after a market salary and capex, the senior loan, the annual debt service, the debt service coverage ratio (DSCR) against an initial-acquisition reference of 1.25 and an illustrative conventional reference of 1.50. These do not determine eligibility or approval. Use this first when the user has a price and earnings. Illustrative, not a commitment.

addBacksRejected.description: Add-backs the buyer cannot document. Deducted from earnings. In US dollars.

capexAllowance.description: Annual maintenance capital spending. Deducted from earnings. In US dollars.

equityPercent.description: Buyer equity as a percentage of the purchase price. Default 20.

existingDebtService.description: Annual payments on debt the business keeps after closing. In US dollars.

interestRate.description: Senior loan rate. Annual rate in percentage points. 9.25 means 9.25%.

ownerMarketSalary.description: What it costs to pay someone to run the business. Deducted from earnings. In US dollars.

purchasePrice.description: The purchase price. In US dollars.

reportedEarnings.description: The seller's stated SDE or EBITDA, before any haircut. In US dollars.

sellerNoteAmount.description: Seller note principal, if any. In US dollars.

sellerNoteRate.description: Seller note rate. Annual rate in percentage points. 9.25 means 9.25%.

sellerNoteStandby.description: True when the seller note is on full standby until the senior loan is repaid.

name: check_deal_affordability
title: Check deal affordability
